maddeler.e:
يتأمرك (form IIq)
# يَتَأَمْرَكُ (yataʔamraku) /ja.ta.ʔam.ra.ku/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَأَمْرَكَ (taʔamraka)
# يُتَأَمْرَكُ (yutaʔamraku) /ju.ta.ʔam.ra.ku/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of تَأَمْرَكَ (taʔamraka)
# يَتَأَمْرَكَ (yataʔamraka) /ja.ta.ʔam.ra.ka/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَأَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
